## 📊 AI Weekly Digest
Every Monday 08:00 → read 4 Google Sheets tabs → split into this-week vs last-week →
compute totals, % change and anomaly flags → 4 GPT-4o-mini section summaries →
GPT-4o-mini "Focus for this week" block → build HTML email → send to Gmail + Slack.

Config — `GOOGLE_SHEET_ID`, `DIGEST_EMAIL_RECIPIENT`, `SLACK_CHANNEL_ID`, `ANOMALY_THRESHOLD` — is referenced as `{{ $env.X }}`.
Either set those in your n8n environment, or paste literal values straight into the nodes (Document ID / To / Channel / threshold).

### Schedule
Cron `0 8 * * 1` = every Monday 08:00.
Runs in this workflow's timezone — set it in this node
or under Workflow → Settings → Timezone
(defaults to your n8n instance timezone).

### Read the data
One read per tab — `Leads`, `Revenue`, `Support`, `Ad Spend`.
The Google Sheets API cannot filter by a relative date range, so each tab
is read in full and the **Calculate Metrics** node splits rows into the
most recently completed Mon–Sun week (current) and the week before it (prior).

### GPT-4o-mini
Four parallel section summaries (`max 150 tokens`) + one Focus block (`max 200 tokens`).
Model: `gpt-4o-mini`. Add an **OpenAI API** credential to every model node.
System prompt lives in each Summarize node — edit it to change tone or focus.
Provider is swappable: replace these with Anthropic/Groq/Gemini/Ollama chat-model nodes — the rest of the flow is unchanged.

messageValues.message: You are a business advisor. Based on the weekly performance data provided, write 3-5 concise bullet points for "Focus for this week". Each bullet must be a specific, actionable recommendation. Start each bullet with an action verb. Maximum 15 words per bullet. Output ONLY the bullets — one per line, each starting with "- ". No preamble, no headers, no closing remarks.
